headline: Nordea Awaits Verdict in Danish Money Laundering Case
summary: Nordea faces a potential fine of 6.6 billion Danish kroner in a money laundering case set to be decided on Monday. Market analysts expect the final penalty to be significantly lower than the maximum amount.
why: Nordea is one of the largest financial institutions in the Nordic region; legal outcomes regarding compliance are significant for its capital position and reputation.

impacts.name: Nordea
impacts.why: The outcome of the legal case will determine the financial impact of potential fines.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The anticipation of a major regulatory fine creates uncertainty for the bank's stock price and capital reserves.
